articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $81,000 as Asian chip rally spills into crypto, pepe jumps 9%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose above $81,400 as Asian chip stocks rallied, with frog-themed memecoin pepe adding 9%.

articles.title: Kospi surges 7% as SK Hynix earnings fuel AI stock rebound
articles.snippet: South Korean chipmakers led a broader AI recovery after SK Hynix reported a sevenfold profit surge and announced another $45 billion in shareholder returns.

articles.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
articles.snippet: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

articles.title: AI Can Quietly Influence Experts’ Decisions, Anthropic Study Finds
articles.snippet: Professional analysts went along with their AI agent’s hidden opinion 86% of the time, and few credited it.

articles.title: Goldman, BlackRock Alumni Raise $4 Million to Put Farm and Apartment Loans Onchain
articles.snippet: Birch Hill, founded by Goldman Sachs and BlackRock alumni, raised $4 million in a seed round led by Multicoin Capital to build a regulated path for bringing U.S. loans onchain.
